judged_text: t[:link] from the disqus export file is passed straight into open() with no validation (import_remote applies no regex or URI check before opening), and Kernel#open executes strings beginning with '|' as shell commands. Importing a disqus export received from a third party whose thread link field is '| <command>' executes that command on the operator's machine during the thor task — arbitrary command execution from an untrusted input file.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes the Disqus thor import to call `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], ...)` (lib/tasks/disqus.thor). `TopicEmbed.import_remote` then calls `open(url).read` directly with no URI/regex validation (app/models/topic_embed.rb). Since `Kernel#open` treats strings beginning with `|` as shell commands, a malicious `t[:link]` value like `"| <cmd>"` from an untrusted Disqus export could execute arbitrary commands before any later `http(s)` check in `TopicEmbed.import`.
